sources.excerpt: ABR-OD – Tallon Electric Skip to content Home Products Contact About Search More Home Products Contact About More Search Account Cart 0 ABR-OD Nobody shreds like August Burns Red 22 reviews Constellations Green Stripe Gold Stripe U Logo Black $189.00 ADD TO CART The ABR-OD is the only overdrive on earth with the specific EQ, clipping, and tonal balances preferred by August Burns Red guitarists JB Brubaker, Brent Rambler, and Dustin Davidson. CONTROLS: + LEVEL: Sets the overall output volume BITE: Emphasizes your presence and pick attack DRIVE: Treat your signal to some crunchy gain and compression before it hits your high gain amp The EQ TOGGLE selects between two distinct voicings: DROP mode maintains a clear low end and top it off with some sizzle. Optimized for low tunings. TIGHT mode is the ideal foundation for building a nimble, punchy tone. TECH SPECS: + POWER SUPPLY NOT INCLUDED . Batteries not accepted. 9VDC, 2.1mm center negative power required Power consumption: 30mA Soft touch momentary footswitch Enclosure size: 4.7" x 3.75" x 1.75 VIEW OPERATION MANUAL (PDF) → SEE IT IN ACTION MORE + CUSTOMER REVIEWS Customer Reviews Based on 22 reviews Write a review 68% (15) 9% (2) 18% (4) 5% (1) 0% (0) N Nurse Patrick So sweet... Aggressive and nasty, sweet and chewy, clear and quiet. It lets me roll off my volume knob, while engaged, and finger pick cleanly. Then I turn it back up and instant face melting. My only real gripe is the box is a bit big. K Kyle Scouten AMAZING!!! Killer overdrive for tight modern metal tones. A Aubrey Adour Badass little pedal! I got the ABR Constellations OD pedal as a gift for Father's Day, and it was absolutely perfect. Sounds insane and looks beautiful. Could not be happier - I hope these guys keep up the awesome work!
